name: Probe the field's other languages with native terms
when: the field has a historiography in German, French, Dutch, Italian or Russian that English vocabulary does not reach
shape: lang=<code> with native-language terms and a native surname ("Sozialisierung" Hilferding; "capitalismo di Stato"); 3-6 probes per language, more only where they yield
yields: the non-English scaffold (Walpen, Denord on neoliberalism; Dutch-maritime monographs on EIC/VOC) — the class English search never surfaces
misses: translated titles indexed under the English title; sparse corpora where multi-term stacks return nothing (keep probes short)
origin: gs_revamp neoliberalism run 1 (2026-09-01): 15 German + 5 French probes; EIC runs 2-6 Dutch flank
